RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the May 9, 2007/Vaisakha 19, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commer ce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Information and
Broadcasting; Labour and Employment; Parliamentary Affairs; Rural
Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
152
Welfare measures for weavers
†*481. SHRI ALI ANWAR: Will the
Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) the steps being taken by the Central
Government and the State Governments
for the welfare and economic self-
dependency of weavers, especially of the
minority class, in the country;
(b) the State-wise details of the works
related to development of skills and
entrepreneurship amongst the weavers; and
(c) the details of the total amount
provided by the State Governments
alongwith the amount spent for the
purpose?
100 days employment not provided
under NREGA
†*482. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
provision for at least 100 days
employment under the National Rural
Employment Guarantee Act;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) whether it is also a fact that 100
days of employment have not been
provided in any State of the country; if so,
the reasons therefor; and
(c) the types of works undertaken under
this programme, alongwith the proportion
of each type of work?
Improving the condition of unorganised
agricultural labourers
*483. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the steps being taken or proposed
to be taken to take care of and improve the
working conditions of unorganized
agricultural labourers in the country;
(b) whether Government propose to
instruct the concerned authorities at district
levels to be more sensitive to the problems
and grievances of the unorganized
agricultural labourers; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?

153
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Pension to freedom fighters
†*484. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: W ill the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the High Court of Delhi
expressed displeasure in March, 2007, with
regard to the attitude of the department
dealing with pension of freedom fighters in
the Ministry of Home Affairs, in the matter
of non-payment of pension to senior
freedom fighters, inspite of the order of the
Court;
(b) if so, the details in this regard; and
(c) whether Government have taken any
action against the concerned officers for
non-compliance of the High Court's order
of March, 2006 directing the payment of
pension by February, 2007, and have taken
any steps to ensure payment of pension to
the eligible freedom fighters?
Increase of pay scales of Army
personnel
*485. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
proposal to increase the pay scales of Army
personnel;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether the increase in pay will
cover all the three services of Armed Forces?
Self-Help Groups in the country
*486. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) how many Self-Help Groups have
been formed in each State and Union
Territory of the country;
(b) how many of these SHGs have
become self-dependent, to cater to the needs
of the families connected with them;
(c) whether it is a fact that the SHGs
are not able to get financial assistance from
the nationalised banks in many cases; and
(d) if so, the remedial measures
Government propose to take in such cases?
Controversy over the SEZ scheme
*487. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the M inister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Special
Economic Zones and the policy of land
acquisition have become controversial as
stated in media reports;
(b) if so, what steps Government would
take to delink the Special Economic Zones
Policy from the forced land acquisitions;
(c) the steps proposed to remove land
acquisition and accompanying corruption
from the Special Economic Zone Scheme;
and
(d) the schedule for such action?
Defining industrially backward
districts
*488. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any reference has been made
to the Planning Commission to conduct a
survey to arrive at a comprehensive,
scientifically verifiable definition of
industrially backward districts;

(d) whether there is any package of
incentives to promote industrialization in

Andhra Pradesh during the Eleventh Five
